translation:
  text: '“The believers from the sixth mountain, which had large and small cracks and withered plants
    in the cracks, are like this:


    2. “Those with small cracks are people who hold things against one another. Their slanders have withered
    them in faith. But many of them repented of these things. The others too will repent when they hear
    my commandments, for their slanders are small, and they will quickly repent.”


    3. “Those with large cracks persist in their slanders and become resentful, nursing anger against
    one another. So they were thrown out of the tower and rejected from its building. People like this
    will live only with difficulty.”


    4. “If our God and Lord,[a] who rules over all and has authority over all his creation, does not hold
    a grudge against those who confess their sins but is merciful, how can a mortal person, full of sins,
    hold a grudge against another person as though able to destroy or save them?”


    5. “I, the messenger of repentance, tell all of you who have this disposition: put it away and repent.
    The Lord will heal your former sins if you cleanse yourselves of this demon. Otherwise, you will be
    handed over to it for death.”'
  philosophy: optimal-equivalence
